column1: # What the owner recited in each kept session (tools/recite/owner.py → the bench scores those words):
# āyāt, or an āya's words first-last (1-based). From large-v3-turbo's and small's transcriptions on
# a PC (diag.yml, experiment.yml) and the app's own log of the session. Then, if the recitation
# didn't start at the passage's beginning, the āya where the app stood when the session began
# (recite.start / recite.partial "from" in the diagnostics): the āyāt before it count as recited.
